DIOR

DIOR Staff Meeting & Leisure

Paphos & Nicosia, Cyprus · 15–19 May 2024 · 450 guests

LocationPaphos & Nicosia, Cyprus
Dates15–19 May 2024
Guests450 guests
PhotographyThomas Saito
Watch the film →

Five days, two Cypriot cities, 450 guests. DIOR brought its team to Cyprus for a staff meeting woven through with leisure — the GPS traces in the photography place the programme in Paphos from 15 to 19 May 2024, with a second cluster of frames shot in Nicosia.

Canon frames in the set carry photographer Thomas Saito’s credit, alongside Sony full-frame and on-the-ground iPhone coverage from the team — the full gallery below is published as captured.
